top_signals.title: Gold Steadies as Conflicting Iran Signals Cloud Path for Rates
top_signals.summary: Gold held a decline as conflicting signals on efforts to end the Iran war clouded the outlook for inflation and the Federal Reserve’s path for interest rates.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: France’s borrowing costs poised to hit 5% for first time since 2002
top_signals.summary: Concerns over public finances and political stability have helped push up 10-year bond yields from 3.2% in late February
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Belgian Government Facing Push to Sell 5.7% BNP Stake
top_signals.summary: Belgium is ramping up efforts to divest from stakes it amassed in banks during the global financial crisis, with some in the government pushing to prioritize the sale of its 5.7% stake in BNP Paribas SA.

top_signals.summary: SpaceX shares jumped after the company reported surging revenue growth in its third quarter, and owner Elon Musk floated a potential SpaceX-Tesla merger.
